title: The Effects of Quota Frequency: Sales Performance and Product Focus
authors: Doug J. Chung; Das Narayandas; Dongkyu Chang
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Field experiment with a single treatment start (period 11 of 20 in the shipped simulated data); treatment group vs. control group of salespeople.
eligible_reason: Not staggered: field experiment changing quota frequency for a treatment group of salespeople at a single common date (trttm switches on at period 11 for all treated). The regression xtreg logq seg1-seg4 i.tm, fe interacts treatment x post with pre-period performance quartiles (subgroup-by-treatment interactions). The package ships only simulated data.
design_notes: Stata xtreg with salesperson FE and period FE; treatment effects by pre-treatment performance quartile (seg1-seg4 = quartile x trtgr x trttm). Package contains only a simulation do-file and simulated data (300 salespeople x 20 periods) generated with effects 0.1, 0, 0, -0.1 by segment.

specs.exclusion_reason: single common treatment date (not staggered); subgroup-by-treatment interactions; synthetic data
specs.treatment_var: seg1 seg2 seg3 seg4 (quartile x trtgr x trttm)

data_files_note: Data_description.docx: 'The data are simulated synthetic data and not the real data as data disclosure is prohibited via a NDA.'
data_provenance_note: Simulated data only (NDA with the Swedish retail chain).
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text or PDF). Field experiment with common start date, segment interactions, synthetic data.
